NIF AST — node kinds following nifspec 2027 Each atom / tag may carry an optional LineInfo suffix and Comment suffix

Types

NifIndexEntry = object
  symbol*: string
  offsetDiff*: int
  offsetAbs*: int
  visibility*: string
NifLineInfo = object
  colDiff*: int
  lineDiff*: int
  hasLineDiff*: bool
  filename*: Option[string]
  rawCol*: string
  rawLine*: string
  rawFilename*: string
  hasAt*: bool
  hasTildeShorthand*: bool
  hasFilename*: bool
Absolute or diff-based? Spec stores diffs relative to parent. We keep decoded signed ints; raw base62 kept for round-trip. 
NifModule = seq[NifNode]
A NIF file is Node+ — directives + root compound(s) 
NifNode {.acyclic.} = ref object
  lineInfo*: Option[NifLineInfo]
  comment*: Option[string]
  rawComment*: string
  rawSuffix*: string
  case kind*: NifNodeKind
  of nkEmpty:
    nil
  of nkIdent:
    ident*: string
    rawIdent*: string
  of nkSymbol:
    symbol*: string
    rawSymbol*: string
  of nkSymbolDef:
    symDef*: string
    rawSymDef*: string
  of nkInt:
    intVal*: int64
    rawInt*: string
  of nkUInt:
    uintVal*: uint64
    rawUInt*: string
  of nkFloat:
    floatVal*: float64
    rawFloat*: string
  of nkCharLit:
    charVal*: string
    rawChar*: string
  of nkStrLit:
    strVal*: string
    rawStr*: string
  of nkCompound, nkDirective:
    tag*: string
    rawTag*: string
    tagLineInfo*: Option[NifLineInfo]
    tagComment*: Option[string]
    rawTagSuffix*: string
    children*: seq[NifNode]
A single NIF node. Compound nodes carry tag+children. Atoms carry value fields. Every node may carry suffix. 
NifNodeKind = enum
  nkEmpty,                  ## '.'
  nkIdent,                  ## identifier
  nkSymbol,                 ## symbol use
  nkSymbolDef,              ## :symbol
  nkInt,                    ## signed integer
  nkUInt,                   ## unsigned with `u` suffix
  nkFloat,                  ## float with '.' or 'E'
  nkCharLit,                ## 'c'
  nkStrLit,                 ## "string"
  nkCompound,               ## (tag children...)
  nkDirective                ## (.directive ...) — subset of nkCompound with tag[0]=='.'
NifOptions = ref object
  moduleSuffix*: string      ## Suffix for global symbol expansion: `foo.0.` -> `foo.0.<moduleSuffix>`
  expandGlobalSymbols*: bool ## When true, parser expands trailing-dot symbols lazily
  maxDepth*: int             ## 0 = unlimited; else max compound nesting
  preserveComments*: bool
  skipUnknownDirectives*: bool
Parser options 
NifSuffix = object
  lineInfo*: Option[NifLineInfo]
  comment*: Option[string]
  rawLineInfo*: string
  rawComment*: string
Suffix ::= LineInfo? Comment? directly after atom/tag with no ws 
OpenParserNifError = object of CatchableError
